# Segmental Spine Kinematics and Loads

## Status

Evidence class: scaffold only, not approved. This provisional chapter
inventories the segmental-spine pathway of epic #12735 so it can be governed.
No calculation is registered. The registry blocker
`UP-D1-segmental-spine-inventory` stays open until the implementing children
land, UP-D1 inventories the pathway and a human reviews it.

The standalone research reference is
`docs/research/segmental_spine/segmental_spine.tex`. It is editable separately
from this manual and is not a manual artifact.

## Conventions

- Per-level transform maps the superior vertebra frame into the inferior frame;
  the chain composes caudal factor first and angles never add.
- Vertebral axes follow ISB: X anterior, Y cranial, Z right; joint angles use
  the ZXY sequence.
- Loads are the force and moment exerted on the superior body by the inferior
  body, expressed in the inferior vertebra frame; compression is positive F_y.

The binding record is ADR-0055.

## Non-Claims

No numerical result about any golfer, no validated spine load, and no
qualified coupling law. Couplers prescribe kinematics only.
